name: Dudigital Global Ltd.
summary: Dudigital Global Ltd. is an India-based company operating in the digital services and technology sector, specializing as an outsourcing and technology solutions provider for governments and diplomatic missions globally. The company primarily offers visa processing services, including visa application handling, biometric data collection, document verification, and consular services. It also provides passport services, e-visa solutions, identity management, and various citizen services. Dudigital Global serves as an intermediary between visa applicants and sovereign governments, managing cross-border administrative workflows through its network of Visa Application Centers and Indian Consular Application Centers. The company also offers additional services such as company formation, immigration, residency, and citizenship programs, and operates the DuVisas digital platform for visa processing and tracking. Its target markets include governmental entities, diplomatic missions, and individual travelers and businesses worldwide.
